---
format:
  html:
    output-file: index.html
    theme: default
    toc: false
    page-layout: full
    css: |
      body {
        max-width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }

      .quarto-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }

      .family-tree {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        margin: 1em 0;
        border: 1px solid #ddd;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 0.5em;
        background-color: #fafafa;
      }

      .family-tree svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        margin: 0 auto;
        min-height: 600px;
      }

      .family-tree img {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        margin: 0 auto;
        min-height: 600px;
      }

      /* Interactive hover effects only for tree connections */
      .tree-connection {
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .tree-connection:hover {
        transform: scale(1.05);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3));
      }

      .tree-connection:hover path {
        stroke-width: 3 !important;
      }

      .tree-connection:hover text {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 11px;
      }

      .tree-description {
        margin-top: 1em;
        padding: 1em;
        background-color: #f8f9fa;
        border-left: 4px solid #007bff;
        font-style: italic;
      }

      h1, h2, h3 {
        color: #333;
        border-bottom: 2px solid #007bff;
        padding-bottom: 0.5em;
        text-align: center;
        margin: 1em 0;
      }

      /* Ensure footer scrolls with page */
      footer, .footer {
        position: static !important;
        margin-top: 2em;
        padding: 1em;
      }

      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .family-tree {
          margin: 0.5em 0;
          padding: 0.3em;
        }

        .family-tree svg,
        .family-tree img {
          min-height: 400px;
        }
      }

## Hodges line

::: family-tree
<object data="output/Hodges_line.html" type="text/html" style="width: 100%; height: 610px;"></object>

Notes: 
[Hodges-Hodge Patriarch Page](https://www.hodges-hodge-society.org/pats.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com) shows members from several lineages that settled in Central Texas.

*Several potential matches for William Hodges, father of James William Hodges (b. 1881) are 1) [JW Hodges (1862-1908)](https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/98279130/j-w-hodges), 2) [William David Hodges (1852-1924)](https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/42648839/william_david-hodges), 3) [William Jasper Hodges (1865-1924)](https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/139029101/william_jasper-hodges)

**Ellen's sister, Dinah Casandra Dickerson (or Dickinson) (b. 1883), married the brother of James William Hodges, [John David Hodges (1878-1944)](https://ancestors.familysearch.org/en/L21M-5YS/john-david-hodges-1878-1944).


This webpage was created by <a href="https://lchogal.github.io/cv/">Leslie Hodges Gallagher</a>, granddaughter of Chauncey William Hodges (1910-1977). Research relied on crowd-sourced information from Geni.com, WikiTree.com, FamilySearch.org, and FindAGrave.com. The current tree, published January 2026, should be considered a working draft while primary historical sources are verified. Family tree diagrams were generated using Python with Graphviz. Supporting files can be found in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/lchogal/Hodges_line). If you have questions or find issues, please contact [hodges.gallagher@gmail.com](mailto:hodges.gallagher@gmail.com).
